create_jwt_settings: create an organization-specific JWT settings model instance with API token TTL and enable flags
encode_truncated_jwt: encode a JWT payload into a truncated token string with header and payload only, no signature
encode_full_jwt: encode a JWT payload into a complete token string with header, payload, and signature
create_lsapi_token: create a long-lived LSAPIToken refresh token with organization-specific lifetime and truncated storage
create_truncated_token: initialize a TruncatedLSAPIToken from a header-payload-only JWT string with a dummy signature appended
